(6) (a) It shall be the duty of a licensee to whom an
enforcement order relates to comply with such order.
(b) A duty is also owed by the licensee to any person
who may be affected by a contravention of the enforcement
order and any such person who sustains any loss or damage
as  a  result  of  such  contravention,  may  institute  an  action
against the licensee in a court of competent jurisdiction, for
damages for such loss or damage.
(c)  In  proceedings  brought  against  a  licensee  under
paragraph (b), it shall be a defence for the licensee to prove
that the licensee took all reasonable steps and exercised all
due diligence, to avoid contravening the enforcement order.
